excluded: claim of proving randomness or predictability

joint_null: conditional on game, number_space_version and documented_draw_process_version, draws are independent across observed issues and each zone is a fixed-cardinality uniform sample without replacement; zones follow the documented separate draw procedure
calendar_policy: preserve exact observed issues, dates, missing issues and generation-segment membership; regenerate numbers only and do not create unobserved draws

power_calendar_policy.n_at_or_below_historical: use the first n real calendar-ordered issue IDs for that game; n=200 exactly preserves every observed issue and gap
power_calendar_policy.n_above_historical: retain all 200 observed issue IDs, then append monotonically increasing synthetic integer IDs solely for prospective power sizing
power_calendar_policy.synthetic_label_rule: all appended issue IDs are simulation labels, parity-balanced by consecutive construction, and never represented as observed draws

multiplicity_family: Holm step-down correction across exactly ten primary candidate decisions: five registered families in each of two games. CAL-01 reproduces this exact ten-decision family on independent complete-null worlds. Negative controls are separately calibrated diagnostics under P2-A01 and can never become candidate signals

practical_effect_registry.parameter_definition: largest absolute difference between a number inclusion probability and its uniform-null probability
practical_effect_registry.direction: larger absolute value is more discrepant
practical_effect_registry.threshold_rationale: one percentage-point persistent inclusion shift is the smallest operationally meaningful boundary; smaller shifts are treated as practically null

practical_effect_registry.parameter_definition: absolute change in expected sum of a tested zone
practical_effect_registry.threshold_rationale: a sustained one-unit shift in a zone sum is interpretable while remaining small relative to the legal range

practical_effect_registry.parameter_definition: largest absolute pair co-inclusion probability difference from the fixed-cardinality null
practical_effect_registry.threshold_rationale: half a percentage point in pair co-inclusion is the preregistered practical boundary

practical_effect_registry.parameter_definition: largest absolute inclusion-probability difference between early and late calendar halves
practical_effect_registry.threshold_rationale: two percentage points separates practically material drift from ordinary small fluctuation

practical_effect_registry.parameter_definition: bias-corrected Cramer's V between fixed null-tercile bins of front and back sums
practical_effect_registry.threshold_rationale: V=0.10 is the registered small-association engineering boundary

monte_carlo_design.interval_method: two-sided Clopper-Pearson exact binomial intervals; one-sided exact bounds for acceptance thresholds; Monte Carlo p=(exceedances+1)/(B+1)
monte_carlo_design.simultaneous_power_band: Clopper-Pearson intervals with Bonferroni alpha allocation across all 240 frozen game by family by effect by sample-size grid points; POW-03 applies to boundary-selection rows whose estimated power is between 0.70 and 0.90

historical_effect_interval.method: Neyman inversion over the frozen original-unit effect grid: include theta when the observed estimator falls inside the independent reference generator's central 95 percent acceptance interval; report the hull and the complete discrete confidence set
historical_effect_interval.candidate_rule: the complete confidence-set hull must lie wholly above the practical-null upper boundary; an empty or disconnected unsupported set is conservative and cannot create a candidate

alternative_generator_registry.definition: number 1 is included with probability k/N+delta; conditional on inclusion fill k-1 uniformly from the remaining N-1, otherwise draw k uniformly from the remaining N-1
alternative_generator_registry.target_effect_mapping: population max absolute inclusion deviation equals delta

alternative_generator_registry.definition: with probability q=mu/(sum(top-k)-E0(sum)) emit the legal top-k combination, otherwise emit a uniform legal combination
alternative_generator_registry.target_effect_mapping: population front-zone mean-sum shift equals mu

alternative_generator_registry.definition: pair (1,2) co-occurs with probability k(k-1)/(N(N-1))+delta; conditional event samples remaining k-2 uniformly, conditional non-event samples uniformly from legal combinations not containing both
alternative_generator_registry.target_effect_mapping: population target-pair co-inclusion deviation equals delta

alternative_generator_registry.definition: calendar first half includes number 1 with probability k/N+delta/2 and second half with probability k/N-delta/2, with uniform conditional fills
alternative_generator_registry.target_effect_mapping: population early-late inclusion difference for number 1 equals delta
alternative_generator_registry.boundary_projection: odd n assigns the extra draw to the late half exactly as the statistic

alternative_generator_registry.definition: mixture of independent uniform zones and a legal same-null-tercile coupling; mixture q is selected before G2 by deterministic bisection on a separate 100000-draw calibration stream
alternative_generator_registry.target_effect_mapping: calibrated population bias-corrected Cramer's V within absolute tolerance 0.015
alternative_generator_registry.boundary_projection: if endpoint cannot reach v the scenario is invalid and G2 fails

power_execution_rule: for every non-temporal game-family-effect point generate each legal alternative world once at max n=2000 and evaluate all five frozen statistics at every registered n prefix. For temporal_instability, whose early/late estimand changes with each midpoint, generate an independent legal world at each registered n using the registered domain-separated n seed. The other game's five p-values come from a complete row of an independent legal complete-null evaluation corpus. Holm therefore receives the target game's actual five-test dependence plus the other game's null dependence. Ties use >= for Monte Carlo exceedances and p=(b+1)/(B+1)
calibration_decision_rule: CAL-01 and CAL-02 acceptance are evaluated only at actual historical n=200, frozen before simulation; other registered n values are reported as diagnostics and are not selected post hoc for acceptance

sensitivity_registry.operation: remove latest ten percent of calendar-ordered draws, retain the full-sample selected component, and recompute its signed effect
sensitivity_registry.direction_rule: PASS only when the nonzero full-sample selected signed effect and trimmed signed effect have the same sign; cross-zone uses signed covariance of zone sums
sensitivity_registry.candidate_failure_semantics: a failed or zero-direction sensitivity prevents candidate_signal and is reported, but does not by itself fail phase delivery

seed_derivation.algorithm: SHA-256 domain separation of the registered integer seed and the exact hierarchical domain string

replay_grid_tolerance.rule: source and independent-seed simultaneous Clopper-Pearson intervals must overlap at every frozen grid point
